title: Leakage-Aware Re-evaluation, Confidence Calibration, and Conformal Selective Prediction for Trustworthy Real-World Waste Classification: code, splits and results
description:
Code, leakage-aware grouped cross-validation splits, duplicate groups and final results for the paper Leakage-Aware Re-evaluation, Confidence Calibration, and Conformal Selective Prediction for Trustworthy Real-World Waste Classification (Prayitno and Putra, Scientific Reports, under review).

The pipeline detects exact and near-duplicate images (MD5, pHash/dHash, DINOv2 cosine), builds grouped stratified five-fold splits with separate calibration-fit and conformal-calibration subsets, trains six architectures on RealWaste, TrashNet and TrashBox (252 runs), evaluates temperature and vector scaling, MC dropout and deep ensembles, split conformal prediction (LAC, APS, RAPS; marginal and class-conditional) and selective prediction, and regenerates every table and figure of the paper. No dataset images are redistributed.

Code: MIT licence. Results, tables, figures and split files: CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md). Per-run prediction probabilities are not included; they are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request. The datasets (RealWaste, TrashNet, TrashBox) are third-party and are not redistributed; see the README for sources, licences and citations.
